track.title: Chahargah: Kereshmeh va Kereshmeh ba Muyeh

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A2 and dwells most on Db in Kereshmeh. Kereshmeh ba Muyeh (0:54.5) introduces E, Fs, Ab, centred on A. The line peaks at Fs4 (362.8 Hz) at 1:13.8. It closes on the tonic (E4 → A2 → A3 → A2 → Ab3 → A3).
